I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience at this Apollo Pharmacy branch. While I expect a certain level of professionalism from a reputed healthcare chain, the service here was abysmal.

Specifically, I want to highlight the behavior of the supervisor, Avnish Yadav. His conduct was highly unprofessional and rude. He lacks basic customer service etiquette and has a very poor attitude toward patients and customers. A supervisor is supposed to solve problems, but his behavior only made the experience worse.

Such a pathetic experience.

featured_reviews.name: Afreen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was on a serious search to find Super Coat Syrup for my pet, and after searching everywhere online and in stores, I couldn’t find it. Thankfully, our vet, Dr. Anoop, referred us to this amazing pet medical store. I placed my order for the syrup in SantaCruz, and while the bottle I received was a little defective (the pump wasn’t working and it arrived without the box), the service I got was truly top-notch.
I called the store to let them know about the issue, and told them I am not in Santa Cruz and away for work, without hesitation, they immediately sent me a replacement bottle, all the way to Vasai. Their prompt response and genuine concern for their customers are worth a solid 10 stars in my book.
The replacement bottle works perfectly, and I really appreciate how honest and dedicated this medical store is to providing quality service. I’m so grateful for their professionalism and highly recommend them to all pet owners!
Thank you for taking care of my pet's needs with such great service!
